analysis.title: Top Stories (McKeon, Sales/Trading), 19 Nov 2026
key_insights: Xi, Trump and Putin agreed at a trilateral meeting on the sidelines of APEC to increase production and supply of refined oil products. They also discussed preventing nuclear war and resolving conflicts including Ukraine and Iran (BBG).

Trump is weighing another round of extensive military strikes on Iran. He is considering new intelligence on Iranian capabilities and pressure from Israel to move quickly and aggressively (NYT, citing US and Israeli officials).

A Houthi missile attack damaged a Riyadh skyscraper that houses Saudi Arabia's sovereign wealth fund PIF, a renewed Mideast escalation (BBG). Separately, armed insurgents in Iran's borderlands are carrying out more attacks on regime security forces (WSJ).
The IEA says the world could end its energy dependence on the Strait of Hormuz with about $240bn of investment in alternative pipelines and new energy supply (FT).
BOJ Governor Ueda signaled that weak consumption will not derail further rate increases. He expects spending to recover as wage gains broaden and inflation slows (BBG).
Australia's October jobs report was weak: employment fell 43.5K against a Street forecast of a 25K gain, and unemployment rose 20bp to 4.9% against a Street 4.7%.
Reuters reports the ECB might raise bank reserve requirements from 1% to 2%, which would drain liquidity from the financial system.

The Texas data-center moratorium has ended much earlier than expected. Regulators have begun approving permits for data-center power sources, including a large off-grid natural gas plant owned by SPCX (Barron's).
US officials and cyber security experts warn that a rush to fix software bugs identified by AI may be behind a recent wave of outages (FT).

Today's US data: Philadelphia Fed (est. 20.1), initial claims (est. 197.5k), continuing claims (est. 1702.5k) and the October Leading Index (est. 0%). Fed speakers include Hammack, Jefferson, Goolsbee, Barr, Barkin and Paulson.

Notable rating changes relayed: MSTR cut to Sell at Monness Crespi, and upgrades of BOX, RGA and UNM at UBS, F at DZ Bank, LIN at Kepler Cheuvreux and EXPD at Citizens. Barclays initiated SNPS and VYLR at Overweight and reinstated CTVA at Equal-Weight.
